title: Switzerland and Italy Honeymoon with a Venice Gondola
alt: A gondola on a quiet back canal in Venice
transport: Rail between cities with a Swiss Travel Pass and private transfers

stops.name: Zurich
stops.subtitle: Zurich → Titlis and Lucerne
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Straightforward hotel in the Zurich West quarter by the rail viaduct

activities.name: Swiss Travel Pass, three days
activities.description: Three days of unlimited travel on Swiss trains, buses and lake boats, with free entry to most of the country's museums.

activities.name: Mount Titlis and the glacier cave
activities.description: The rotating cable car to three thousand metres, the glacier cave, the cliff walk and a chairlift ride over the crevasses.

activities.name: Lucerne walking tour with a lake cruise
activities.description: The covered Chapel Bridge, the Lion Monument and the Glacier Garden on foot, then a boat out onto Lake Lucerne.

activities.name: Lindt Home of Chocolate
activities.description: The chocolate museum at Kilchberg, with the nine metre fountain in the atrium and a tasting room at the end.

program.name: Zurich
program.description: Three nights in Switzerland with a travel pass, the glacier on Mount Titlis, Lake Lucerne and the Lindt chocolate museum.

stops.name: Milan
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Simple hotel a few minutes from Milano Centrale

activities.name: Duomo di Milano skip the line
activities.description: Skip the line entry to the marble cathedral and its museum, with the statues and spires of the roofline above you.

program.name: Milan
program.description: One night in Lombardy with skip the line entry to the Duomo and the Galleria next door.

stops.name: Venice
stops.subtitle: Venice → Murano and Burano
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Canalside hotel in Santa Croce, ten minutes from the station

activities.name: Private gondola ride
activities.description: A private thirty minute gondola by day, just the two of you, threading the back canals before the Grand Canal.

activities.name: Murano and Burano half day trip
activities.description: By boat to the glass furnaces of Murano and the painted fishermen's houses and leaning bell tower of Burano.

program.name: Venice
program.description: Two nights on the lagoon with a private gondola and a boat trip out to the glass island and painted Burano.

day_titles.4: On to Milan and the Duomo
day_titles.5: To Venice and a private gondola

1: Arrival at Zurich Kloten and transfer to your hotel
Your three day Swiss Travel Pass starts today
Check in and the rest of the day free
Optional: the old town and the Bahnhofstrasse
2: Early breakfast, then south towards Engelberg
The rotating cable car up Mount Titlis
The glacier cave, the cliff walk and the chairlift
On to Lucerne for the Chapel Bridge and a lake cruise
3: Breakfast, then out to Kilchberg on the lake
The Lindt chocolate museum and its fountain
A tasting room at the end of the tour
4: Breakfast and check out of your Zurich hotel
Station transfer and the train south to Milan
Check in a few minutes from Milano Centrale
Skip the line entry to the Duomo and its museum
5: Breakfast and check out for the run east
Station transfer and the train on to Venice
Check in at your canalside hotel in Santa Croce
A private thirty minute gondola through the back canals
6: Breakfast, then down to the boat jetty
The painted houses and leaning bell tower of Burano
The afternoon free for St Mark's Square
7: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Venice Marco Polo for your flight home

expert.name: Sharon
expert.quote: The cheapest Switzerland and Italy honeymoon we sell, and it still has a private gondola and the glacier on Titlis in it.
expert.tip: Take the private gondola in the late afternoon rather than at midday. The back canals are quieter and the light on the water is far better.

summary: Seven days from the Swiss Alps to the Venetian lagoon: three nights in Zurich with a travel pass, Mount Titlis and Lake Lucerne, a night in Milan for the Duomo, then Venice with a private gondola and a trip to Murano and Burano.
included: Included: 3 nights in Zurich, 1 night in Milan and 2 nights in Venice with breakfast; private transfers; rail between the cities; a three day Swiss Travel Pass; the Mount Titlis tour with the glacier chairlift; a Lucerne walking tour with a lake cruise; Lindt Home of Chocolate tickets; skip the line Duomo di Milano tickets; a private thirty minute gondola ride; a half day Murano and Burano trip.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Schengen visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
